# Traits

```{r}
trait_list <- list(
  largePel = list(
    a_a = 80, b_R = 0.85, #0.58,                                                 # active metabolism scale, speed geometry (p = 3 - b_R); a_a = 80
    a_g = 3, hm = 1,                                                            # gill diffusion: S = A_g*(pO2_env - pO2_int)*Q10_o/hm
    f_m = 0.1, a_m = 1,  b_m = 0.75,                                            # basal metabolism scale (fraction of a_c); f_m = 0.1
    a_e = 200, b_e=2/3, #200 #2/3                                                         # encounter
    a_c = 60, b_c = 0.75, epsAssim = 0.7, alpha = 0.2,                          # consumption (+ SDA fraction alpha)
    T_ref = 10,
    Q10_m = 2.00, Q10_a = 1.80, Q10_o = 1.50, Q10_c = 2.00                      # temperature Q10s
  )
)

group <- "largePel"
tr <- trait_list[[group]]
```


# Theme

```{r}
# --- Minimal square theme with grey50 outline ---------------------------
# Theme
base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey50", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.title = element_text(size=8),
    legend.text  = element_text(size=6, color="gray30"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "grey50"),
    #axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)
  )

# --- Isolines ---
panel_breaks_pos <- function(df, zcol, n_lines = 3) {
  z <- df[[zcol]]
  z <- z[is.finite(z) & z > 0]
  if (!length(z)) return(numeric())
  rng  <- range(z)
  brks <- seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = n_lines + 2)
  brks[2:(length(brks) - 1)]
}

# Legend helper (slim framed bar)
legend_bar_guide <- function(breaks, labels) {
  guide_colorbar(
    direction      = "horizontal",
    title.position = "top",
    label.position = "bottom",
    ticks          = TRUE,
    frame.colour   = "grey50",
    #ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
    frame.linewidth= 0.5,
    legend.ticks.length = unit(c(-10, 0), 'pt'),
    #barheight      = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
    #barwidth       = grid::unit(10, "lines"),  # try to span the panel width
    # If your ggplot2 ignores npc here, bump this number instead:
    # barwidth    = grid::unit(36, "lines")
    ticks.colour   = "grey50"
  )
}

# --- Optional: hide y labels/text when you don't want them ---------------
theme_hide_y_labels <- function() {
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = element_blank())
}
```



# Fig. 2

```{r}
# Parameters
mass   <- 1e0                                                                   # [g] 1e3
T      <- 5                                                                    # [°C]
f_seq  <- seq(0.0, 1.0, by = 0.002)                                             # []
pO2seq <- seq(0, 30, by=0.05)                                                   # [kPa]

# Calculate surface
surf_Fbudgets <- compute_state_surface(
  tr,                                                                           # consider re-adjusting if you add other functional groups
  masses = mass,
  Tseq = T,
  pO2seq = pO2seq,
  preys = f_seq,
  prey_units = "prey_index", 
  pair_mode = "cross"
)

surf_Fbudgets <- add_regime_labels_ingestion(surf_Fbudgets)
```


```{r warning=FALSE}
# Subplots
## ---Consumption---
surf_Fbudgets$consump_norm <- surf_Fbudgets$consump / surf_Fbudgets$Cmax

consump_na  <- dplyr::filter(surf_Fbudgets, !is.finite(consump_norm) | is.na(consump_norm))
consump_neg <- dplyr::filter(surf_Fbudgets,  is.finite(consump_norm) & consump_norm < 0)
consump_pos <- dplyr::filter(surf_Fbudgets,  is.finite(consump_norm) & consump_norm >= 0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(consump_pos = consump_norm)

E_breaks <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
E_labels <- sprintf("%.1f", E_breaks)

p_consump_Fbudgets <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = consump_na,  aes(f_ref, pO2), fill = "black", interpolate = TRUE) + # NA regions: gray, here 
  geom_raster(data = consump_neg, aes(f_ref, pO2), fill = "black", interpolate = TRUE) + # NEGATIVE region: gray
  geom_raster(data = consump_pos, aes(f_ref, pO2, fill = pmin(consump_pos, 1)), interpolate = TRUE) + # POSITIVE region: white -> blue gradient (capped to per-column vmax)
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white", high = "#67A5CA", na.value = "black",
    limits = c(0, 0.7), breaks = E_breaks, labels = E_labels,                     # <- extremes tied to max positive
    oob = scales::squish,                                                       # <- clamp out-of-bounds values
    #name   = expression("Available energy,"~nu~"(normalized by " * C[max] * ")"),
    name   = expression("Consumption"),
    guide = legend_bar_guide(E_breaks, E_labels)
  ) +
  geom_contour(
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    data = consump_pos, aes(x = f_ref, y = pO2, z = consump_pos),
    breaks = seq(0, 0.7, length.out=5), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 1, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(x = "Prey index", y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~"(kPa)")#,
       #title = paste("Available Energy")
       ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(f_seq), max(f_seq), by = 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(pO2seq), max(pO2seq), by = 10), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  base_theme + 
  theme(aspect.ratio=1,
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "horizontal")

p_consump_Fbudgets

## Limitation regimes
# ---------------------------
# 2) Plot like your U plot: tiles + borders, bottom legend

# Regime palette + levels
reg_levels <- c(
  "Oxygen exclusion",
  "Energetic exclusion",
  "No feeding",
  "Oxygen-limited feeding",
  "Saturated (Cmax-limited)",
  "Encounter-limited feeding"
)

regime_cols <- c(
  "Oxygen exclusion"           = "black",
  "Energetic exclusion"        = "gray60",
  "Oxygen-limited feeding"             = "#8a5796", #"#674776",
  "No feeding"     = "#BEA0C4",
  "Saturated (Cmax-limited)"               = "#ADD946", #"#FDE725FF", #"#C0DD3F",
  "Encounter-limited feeding"             = "#4DB674"
)

# Build a regular grid matrix of class IDs for clean borders
xs <- sort(unique(surf_Fbudgets$f_ref))
ys <- sort(unique(surf_Fbudgets$pO2))
Z_tbl <- tidyr::pivot_wider(surf_Fbudgets[, c("f_ref","pO2","regime")],
                            names_from = pO2, values_from = regime) |>
         dplyr::arrange(f_ref)
Z <- as.matrix(Z_tbl[, -1, drop = FALSE])

# Border levels at midpoints between class IDs
brks <- seq(1.5, length(reg_levels) - 0.5, by = 1)

# Data frame for contour (regular grid)
grid_for_contour <- expand.grid(f_ref = xs, pO2 = ys)
grid_for_contour$class_id <- as.vector(Z)

p_regime_Fbudgets <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = surf_Fbudgets, aes(f_ref, pO2, fill = regime), interpolate = FALSE) +
  geom_contour(
    data = grid_for_contour,
    aes(x = f_ref, y = pO2, z = class_id),
    breaks = brks, colour = "gray60", linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = regime_cols,
    drop   = FALSE,
    name   = "Regime",
    guide  = guide_legend(
      nrow = 6, byrow = TRUE,              # <-- two rows
      keywidth  = unit(3, "mm"),
      keyheight = unit(3,  "mm"),
      override.aes = list(                  # <-- add grey border to swatches
        colour   = "grey50",
        size      = 1,                     # border thickness (stroke)
        linewidth = 1
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Prey index",
    y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~"(kPa)")#,
    #title = "Limitation regimes"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 30), breaks = seq(0, 30, 10), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio      = 1,
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.direction  = "horizontal",
    legend.box        = "horizontal",
    legend.title      = element_blank(), #element_text(),
    legend.text       = element_text(),
    legend.key        = element_rect(colour = "gray50"),   # keep keys clean; border comes from override.aes
    legend.box.spacing= unit(4, "pt")
  )

p_regime_Fbudgets
```

```{r fig.height=3.25, fig.width=6.5, warning=FALSE}
# Helper: remove y-axis text/title/ticks from a plot
strip_y <- function(p) {
  p + theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank()#,
    #axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )
}

# Ensure identical margins so panels line up perfectly
uniform_margins <- margin(8, 8, 8, 8)  # tweak if needed
p1_Eavail_Fbudgets <- p_Eavail_Fbudgets + theme(plot.margin = uniform_margins,
                                               legend.key.height = unit(dev.size()[1] / 50, "inches"))
p2_o2ratio_Fbudgets     <- p_o2ratio_Fbudgets     + theme(plot.margin = uniform_margins,
                                               legend.key.height = unit(dev.size()[1] / 50, "inches"))
p3_U_Fbudgets      <- p_U_Fbudgets      + theme(plot.margin = uniform_margins,
                                               legend.key.height = unit(dev.size()[1] / 50, "inches"))
p4_regime_Fbudgets <- p_regime_Fbudgets + theme(plot.margin = uniform_margins,
                                                legend.text  = element_text(size=6, color="black"))

# Assemble: left plot keeps y-axis; others are stripped
p_Fbudget <-
  (p1_Eavail_Fbudgets | strip_y(p2_o2ratio_Fbudgets) | strip_y(p3_U_Fbudgets) | strip_y(p4_regime_Fbudgets)) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1), guides = "keep") &  # use "collect" if you want a single legend
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Available energy plot (absolute B on x, log10 axis)
#    - O2_margin < 0 -> black
#    - E_net_norm < 0 -> gray60
#    - NA transparent
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

E_O2excl <- dplyr::filter(surf_plot, is.finite(O2_margin) & O2_margin < 0)

E_neg <- dplyr::filter(
  surf_plot,
  is.finite(E_net_norm) & E_net_norm < 0 &
    !(is.finite(O2_margin) & O2_margin < 0)
)

E_pos <- dplyr::filter(
  surf_plot,
  is.finite(E_net_norm) & E_net_norm >= 0 &
    !(is.finite(O2_margin) & O2_margin < 0)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(E_pos = pmin(E_net_norm, 1))
```

```{r}
pO2_star_from_profile_margin <- function(df_profile,
                                         eps_excl = 1e-6) {

  dd <- df_profile %>%
    arrange(pO2) %>%
    mutate(
      oxy_excl = !is.finite(U_opt) | !is.finite(O2_margin) | (O2_margin < -eps_excl)
    ) %>%
    filter(!oxy_excl, is.finite(pO2), is.finite(O2_margin))

  if (nrow(dd) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  g <- dd$O2_margin

  # If already slack at the lowest pO2, threshold is below your range
  if (g[1] > 0) return(dd$pO2[1])

  # If never slack in range, threshold is above your max pO2
  if (all(g <= 0)) return(NA_real_)

  # first index where margin becomes positive
  j <- which(g > 0)[1]
  i <- j - 1

  p1 <- dd$pO2[i]; p2 <- dd$pO2[j]
  g1 <- g[i];      g2 <- g[j]

  p1 + (0 - g1) * (p2 - p1) / (g2 - g1)
}


# Apply across mass × T
pO2_star_tbl <- surf_B1000 %>%
  group_by(mass, T) %>%
  group_modify(~ tibble(pO2_star = pO2_star_from_profile_margin(.x))) %>%
  ungroup()

pO2_star_tbl
```

```{r}
# ---- 1) fit model (skip if you already have mod) --------------------
fit_df <- pO2_star_tbl %>%
  filter(is.finite(pO2_star), pO2_star > 0)

mod <- lm(log(pO2_star) ~ log(mass) + T, data = fit_df)

# ---- 2) prediction grid --------------------------------------------
T_grid <- seq(min(fit_df$T), max(fit_df$T), length.out = 200)

mass_lines <- c(1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1, 10, 1e2, 1e3, 1e4)  # choose your masses

  T = T_grid,
  mass = mass_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    log_pO2_hat = predict(mod, newdata = .),
    pO2_hat = exp(log_pO2_hat),
    mass_f = factor(mass, levels = mass_lines,
                    labels = paste0("m = ", format(mass_lines, scientific = TRUE), " g"))
  )

# ---- 3) plot: pO2 vs T with lines for masses ------------------------

  # optional: empirical points (subsample if huge)
  geom_point(
    data = fit_df %>% filter(mass %in% mass_lines),
    aes(x = T, y = pO2_star, color = factor(mass)),
    alpha = 0.35, size = 1
  ) +
  geom_line(

    aes(x = T, y = pO2_hat, color = mass_f),
```

# Other emergent variables

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers: crossing finders along B (in log10-space)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Generic "find B where y crosses a threshold", scanning B increasing.
# Returns interpolated B (not logB) at the first crossing from one side to the other.
B_crossing_from_profile <- function(df_profile,
                                    ycol,
                                    thresh = 0,
                                    direction = c("neg_to_pos","pos_to_neg"),
                                    require_finite = TRUE) {

  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  dd <- df_profile %>%
    filter(is.finite(B_used)) %>%
    arrange(B_used) %>%
    mutate(logB = log10(B_used))

  if (require_finite) {
    dd <- dd %>% filter(is.finite(.data[[ycol]]), is.finite(logB))
  }
  if (nrow(dd) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  y <- dd[[ycol]] - thresh

  # determine sign regions
  neg <- y < 0
  pos <- y > 0
  zer <- y == 0

  # Treat exact zeros as a valid crossing at that B (take smallest B with y==0)
  if (any(zer)) {
    return(dd$B_used[min(which(zer))])
  }

  if (direction == "neg_to_pos") {
    # want first index where y becomes positive after being negative
    if (!any(neg) || !any(pos)) return(NA_real_)
    i_last_neg <- max(which(neg))
    j_first_pos <- which(pos & (seq_along(pos) > i_last_neg))[1]
    if (is.na(j_first_pos)) return(NA_real_)
  } else {
    # pos_to_neg
    if (!any(neg) || !any(pos)) return(NA_real_)
    i_last_pos <- max(which(pos))
    j_first_neg <- which(neg & (seq_along(neg) > i_last_pos))[1]
    if (is.na(j_first_neg)) return(NA_real_)
    i_last_neg <- i_last_pos
    j_first_pos <- j_first_neg
  }

  # interpolate in logB between the bracketing points
  x1 <- dd$logB[i_last_neg]; x2 <- dd$logB[j_first_pos]
  y1 <- y[i_last_neg];       y2 <- y[j_first_pos]

  if (!is.finite(y1) || !is.finite(y2) || abs(y2 - y1) < 1e-12) {
    return(10^(0.5 * (x1 + x2)))
  }

  x_star <- x1 + (0 - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)
  10^x_star
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Targets:
#   B_E0(pO2): E_net crosses 0 from negative to positive as B increases
#   B_cross(pO2): O2_margin crosses 0 from positive to negative as B increases
#                 (oxygen starts binding) -- optionally require E_net>0
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

B_E0_from_profile <- function(df_profile) {
  # If E_net already >0 at smallest B, return that smallest B (already viable)
  dd <- df_profile %>% filter(is.finite(B_used), is.finite(E_net)) %>% arrange(B_used)
  if (nrow(dd) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  if (dd$E_net[1] > 0) return(dd$B_used[1])
  # Find crossing E_net = 0 (neg -> pos)
  B_crossing_from_profile(dd, ycol = "E_net", thresh = 0, direction = "neg_to_pos")
}

B_cross_from_profile <- function(df_profile, require_Epos = TRUE) {
  dd <- df_profile %>%
    filter(is.finite(B_used), is.finite(O2_margin)) %>%
    arrange(B_used)

  if (require_Epos) {
    dd <- dd %>% filter(is.finite(E_net), E_net > 0)
  }
  if (nrow(dd) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  # Oxygen "binds" when margin <= 0; slack when margin > 0.
  # As B increases, margin typically declines; crossing is pos -> neg.
  B_crossing_from_profile(dd, ycol = "O2_margin", thresh = 0, direction = "pos_to_neg")
}

# Compute surfaces for requested sizes and temperatures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

}
surf_all <- bind_rows(surfaces)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

  group_by(mass, T, pO2) %>%
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ---------- robust crossing helpers (same as before) ----------
B_crossing_from_profile <- function(df_profile, ycol, thresh = 0,
                                    direction = c("neg_to_pos","pos_to_neg")) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)
  dd <- df_profile %>%
    filter(is.finite(B_used), B_used > 0, is.finite(.data[[ycol]])) %>%
    arrange(B_used) %>%
    mutate(logB = log10(B_used),
           y = .data[[ycol]] - thresh)

  if (nrow(dd) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  # exact hits
  if (any(dd$y == 0)) return(dd$B_used[min(which(dd$y == 0))])

  neg <- dd$y < 0
  pos <- dd$y > 0
  if (!any(neg) || !any(pos)) return(NA_real_)

  if (direction == "neg_to_pos") {
    i <- max(which(neg))
    j <- which(pos & (seq_along(pos) > i))[1]
  } else {
    i <- max(which(pos))
    j <- which(neg & (seq_along(neg) > i))[1]
  }
  if (is.na(j)) return(NA_real_)

  x1 <- dd$logB[i]; x2 <- dd$logB[j]
  y1 <- dd$y[i];    y2 <- dd$y[j]
  if (abs(y2 - y1) < 1e-12) return(10^(0.5*(x1+x2)))

  xstar <- x1 + (0 - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)
  10^xstar
}

B_E0_from_profile <- function(df_profile) {
  # E_net crosses 0 from negative to positive as B increases
  dd <- df_profile %>% filter(is.finite(E_net)) %>% arrange(B_used)
  if (nrow(dd) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  # if already positive at min B, return min B
  if (dd$E_net[1] > 0) return(dd$B_used[1])
  B_crossing_from_profile(dd, ycol="E_net", thresh=0, direction="neg_to_pos")
}

B_cross_from_profile <- function(df_profile, require_Epos = TRUE) {
  dd <- df_profile %>% filter(is.finite(O2_margin)) %>% arrange(B_used)
  if (require_Epos) dd <- dd %>% filter(is.finite(E_net), E_net > 0)
  if (nrow(dd) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  # O2_margin crosses 0 from positive (slack) to negative (binding) as B increases
  B_crossing_from_profile(dd, ycol="O2_margin", thresh=0, direction="pos_to_neg")
}

# ---------- grids ----------

pO2_ref <- 10                              # choose a representative oxygen (kPa); change if desired

# B search grid: widen if needed

# compute only at pO2_ref to focus the allometry figure

  tr,
  masses     = masses,

  pO2seq     = pO2_ref,
  prey_units = "biomass",
  preys      = B_seq,
  pair_mode  = "cross",
  D = 3,
  u_prey = 0
)

# derive thresholds at each (mass,T)
thresh_tbl <- surf_ref %>%
  group_by(mass, T, pO2) %>%
  group_modify(~tibble(
    B_E0    = B_E0_from_profile(.x),
    B_cross = B_cross_from_profile(.x, require_Epos = TRUE)
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log10m = log10(mass),
         log10_BE0 = log10(B_E0),
         log10_Bcross = log10(B_cross),
         T_lbl = factor(paste0(T,"°C"), levels=c("5°C","30°C")))
```

# Temperature growth parameter

```{r}
# ============================================================
# FIGURES: E(T) and emergent Q10_E vs pO2, across masses
# Uses your compute_state_surface() output (E_net, O2_margin, etc.)
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# ----------------------------
# 0) Settings
# ----------------------------
B_fix  <- 1000
D_use  <- 3
u_prey <- 0

# Mass grid for Q10 plot (dense-ish) + a smaller set for the line plot panels
masses_all   <- 10^seq(-3, 4, by = 0.5)                # 1e-3 ... 1e4 g
masses_lines <- c(1e-3, 1e-1, 1e1, 1e3, 1e4)           # for faceted E(T) lines

Tseq   <- seq(0, 20, by = 0.5)
pO2seq <- seq(1, 30, by = 1)                            # avoid 0 for stability

# For the E(T) line plot, show a few pO2 slices
pO2_slices <- c(30, 15, 8, 4)

# Choose response: use absolute E_net (growth proxy)
Ecol <- "E_net"     # or "E_net_norm"


# ----------------------------
# 1) Compute surfaces
# ----------------------------

# (A) Dense for Q10 summary plot
surf_E_all <- compute_state_surface(
  tr,
  masses     = masses_all,
  Tseq       = Tseq,
  pO2seq     = pO2seq,
  prey_units = "biomass",
  preys      = B_fix,
  pair_mode  = "cross",
  D          = D_use,
  u_prey     = u_prey
) %>%
  mutate(
    E = .data[[Ecol]],
    feasible = is.finite(U_opt) & is.finite(O2_margin) & is.finite(E),
    Epos = feasible & (E > 0),
    oxy_limited = feasible & (O2_margin <= 0)          # hard rule; avoids checkerboard
  )

# (B) Smaller for E(T) faceted lines (only a few pO2 values)
surf_E_lines <- surf_E_all %>%
  filter(mass %in% masses_lines, pO2 %in% pO2_slices)


# ----------------------------
# 2) FIGURE 1: E(T) by pO2, faceted by mass (B fixed)
# ----------------------------

# Mark oxygen-limited points along curves (O2_margin <= 0)
p_E_T <- ggplot(surf_E_lines, aes(x = T, y = E, colour = factor(pO2), group = pO2)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  # oxygen-limited overlay as points (black)
  geom_point(
    data = dplyr::filter(surf_E_lines, oxy_limited),
    aes(x = T, y = E),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ mass, scales = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(mass = function(x) paste0("m = ", scientific(as.numeric(x)), " g"))) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)")) +
  labs(
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = if (Ecol == "E_net") "Net energy (E_net)" else "Normalized net energy (E_net_norm)",
    title = paste0("Temperature dependence of ", Ecol, " at B = ", B_fix, " (points = O2 binding)")
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )

p_E_T


# ----------------------------
# 3) Compute emergent Q10 of E
#    Local Q10 over dt degrees, then summarize (median) over a T window
# ----------------------------

dt <- 5
dT <- Tseq[2] - Tseq[1]
k  <- round(dt / dT)          # number of steps for dt

Q10_tbl <- surf_E_all %>%
  group_by(mass, pO2) %>%
  arrange(T, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    E_lead = lead(E, n = k),
    T_lead = lead(T, n = k),
    ok_q10 = Epos & is.finite(E_lead) & (E_lead > 0) & is.finite(T_lead),
    Q10_E  = if_else(ok_q10, (E_lead / E)^(10 / (T_lead - T)), NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Summarize over a temperature band (adjust if you like)
T_lo <- 5
T_hi <- 15

Q10_summary <- Q10_tbl %>%
  filter(T >= T_lo, T <= T_hi) %>%
  group_by(mass, pO2) %>%
  summarize(
    Q10_E_med = median(Q10_E, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_oxy_limited = mean(oxy_limited, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_q10 = sum(is.finite(Q10_E)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # keep only profiles with enough points to be meaningful
  filter(is.finite(Q10_E_med), n_q10 >= 5)


# ----------------------------
# 4) FIGURE 2: Q10_E vs pO2, colored by mass
# ----------------------------

p_Q10_pO2 <- ggplot(Q10_summary, aes(x = pO2, y = Q10_E_med, group = mass, colour = log10(mass))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    name = expression(log[10]*"(mass, g)"),
    option = "D",
    guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(4, "mm"), frame.colour = "grey50", ticks.colour = "grey50")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)"),
    y = paste0("Emergent Q10 of ", Ecol, " (median, ", T_lo, "–", T_hi, "°C)"),
    title = paste0("Does hypoxia flatten temperature dependence?  B = ", B_fix, ", dt = ", dt, "°C")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.8, NA)) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )

p_Q10_pO2


# ----------------------------
# 5) Optional: add a reference line at Q10 = 1.1 (van Denderen-ish)
# ----------------------------
p_Q10_pO2 + geom_hline(yintercept = 1.1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# Inputs expected:
# - surf_F_TpO2space with cols: f_ref, mass, T, pO2, E_net_norm
# - legend_bar_guide(), base_theme already defined

# Breaks/labels for the colorbar
E_breaks <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
E_labels <- sprintf("%.1f", E_breaks)

E_min <- min(surf_F_TpO2space$E_net_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
E_max <- max(surf_F_TpO2space$E_net_norm, na.rm = TRUE)

# Find unique (f_ref, mass) combos
combos <- surf_F_TpO2space |>
  dplyr::distinct(f_ref, mass) |>
  dplyr::arrange(f_ref, mass) |>
  dplyr::mutate(name = paste0("f=", signif(f_ref, 3), " | m=", signif(mass, 3)))

# Container for plots
plots_E <- vector("list", nrow(combos))
names(plots_E) <- combos$name

# Build plots in a simple for-loop
for (i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
  f_i <- combos$f_ref[i]
  m_i <- combos$mass[i]
  nm  <- combos$name[i]

  df_i <- dplyr::filter(surf_F_TpO2space, f_ref == f_i, mass == m_i)

  # Split like your style
  E_na  <- dplyr::filter(df_i, !is.finite(E_net_norm) | is.na(E_net_norm))
  E_neg <- dplyr::filter(df_i,  is.finite(E_net_norm) & E_net_norm < 0)
  E_pos <- dplyr::filter(df_i,  is.finite(E_net_norm) & E_net_norm >= 0) |>
           dplyr::mutate(E_pos = E_net_norm)

  # Axes ranges & ticks
  Tx  <- range(df_i$T,  na.rm = TRUE)
  O2x <- range(df_i$pO2, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_br <- pretty(Tx, n = 6)
  y_br <- seq(ceiling(O2x[1]/10)*10, floor(O2x[2]/10)*10, by = 10)
  if (length(y_br) == 0) y_br <- pretty(O2x, n = 4)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = E_na,  aes(T, pO2), fill = "black",  interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_raster(data = E_neg, aes(T, pO2), fill = "gray60", interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_raster(data = E_pos, aes(T, pO2, fill = pmin(E_pos, 1)), interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_contour(
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      data = E_pos, aes(x = T, y = pO2, z = E_pos),
      breaks = seq(min(E_pos$E_pos), max(E_pos$E_pos), length.out=5), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 1, linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    # { if (dplyr::n_distinct(na.omit(df_i$class_id)) >= 2)
    #     geom_contour(
    #       inherit.aes = FALSE,
    #       data = df_i,
    #       aes(x = T, y = pO2, z = class_id),
    #       breaks = 3.5,             # midpoint between 3 and 4
    #       #linetype = "dashed",
    #       colour = "black",
    #       linewidth = 0.5
    #     )
    #   else NULL } +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white", high = "#67A5CA", na.value = "black",
      limits = c(0, E_max), breaks = E_breaks, labels = E_labels,
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = expression("Available energy"),
      guide = legend_bar_guide(E_breaks, E_labels)
    ) +
    labs(
      #title = nm,
      x = "Temperature (°C)",
      y = expression("Oxygen," ~ p[O[2]] ~ "(kPa)")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(Tseq), max(Tseq), by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(pO2seq), max(pO2seq), by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_x_continuous(limits = Tx,  breaks = x_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_y_continuous(limits = O2x, breaks = y_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio    = 1,
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box      = "horizontal"
    )

  plots_E[[nm]] <- p
}
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
  df_i_mass <- dplyr::filter(surf_F_TpO2space, mass == m_i)
  E_min <- min(df_i_mass$U_opt, na.rm = TRUE)
  E_max <- max(df_i_mass$U_opt, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Split like your style
  E_na  <- dplyr::filter(df_i, !is.finite(U_opt) | is.na(U_opt))
  E_neg <- dplyr::filter(df_i,  is.finite(E_net_norm) & E_net_norm < 0)
  E_pos <- dplyr::filter(df_i,  is.finite(U_opt) & U_opt >= 0) |>
           dplyr::mutate(E_pos = U_opt)

  # Axes ranges & ticks
  Tx  <- range(df_i$T,  na.rm = TRUE)
  O2x <- range(df_i$pO2, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_br <- pretty(Tx, n = 6)
  y_br <- seq(ceiling(O2x[1]/10)*10, floor(O2x[2]/10)*10, by = 10)
  if (length(y_br) == 0) y_br <- pretty(O2x, n = 4)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = E_na,  aes(T, pO2), fill = "black",  interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_raster(data = E_neg, aes(T, pO2), fill = "gray60", interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_raster(data = E_pos, aes(T, pO2, fill = pmin(E_pos, E_max)), interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_contour(
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      data = E_pos, aes(x = T, y = pO2, z = E_pos),
      breaks = seq(min(E_pos$E_pos), max(E_pos$E_pos), length.out=5), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 1, linetype="dashed"
    ) +
    # { if (dplyr::n_distinct(na.omit(df_i$class_id)) >= 2)
    #     geom_contour(
    #       inherit.aes = FALSE,
    #       data = df_i,
    #       aes(x = T, y = pO2, z = class_id),
    #       breaks = 3.5,             # midpoint between 3 and 4
    #       #linetype = "dashed",
    #       colour = "white",
    #       linewidth = 0.5
    #     )
    #   else NULL } +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      na.value = "#440154FF",
      limits = c(0, E_max),                                                           # <- extremes tied to max positive
      oob = scales::squish,                                                        # <- clamp out-of-bounds values
      #name   = expression("Cruising speed,"~U[opt]~"(m/s)"),
      name   = expression("Cruising speed"),
      guide = legend_bar_guide(U_breaks, U_labels)
    ) +
    labs(
      #title = nm,
      x = "Temperature (°C)",
      y = expression("Oxygen," ~ p[O[2]] ~ "(kPa)")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(Tseq), max(Tseq), by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(pO2seq), max(pO2seq), by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_x_continuous(limits = Tx,  breaks = x_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_y_continuous(limits = O2x, breaks = y_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio    = 1,
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box      = "horizontal"
    )

  plots_U[[nm]] <- p
}
```

## Limitation regimes

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Regime palette + levels
reg_levels <- c(
  "Oxygen exclusion",
  "Energetic exclusion",
  "Oxygen limited (strict)",
  "Oxygen limited (prey sensitive)",
  "Prey limited (O2-tightening)",
  "Prey limited (O2-relaxing)"
)

regime_cols <- c(
  "Oxygen exclusion"           = "black",
  "Energetic exclusion"        = "gray60",
  "Oxygen limited (strict)"             = "#8a5796", #"#674776",
  "Oxygen limited (prey sensitive)"     = "#BEA0C4",
  "Prey limited (O2-tightening)"               = "#ADD946", #"#FDE725FF", #"#C0DD3F",
  "Prey limited (O2-relaxing)"             = "#4DB674"
)

surf_F_TpO2space <- add_regime_labels2( # Append regime to the surface
  surf_F_TpO2space,
  use_derivs = TRUE,
  dE_thr = 0.01,
  dO_thr = 0.01
)

# -----------------------------
# Build per-(f_ref, mass) regime plots over T × pO2
combos <- surf_F_TpO2space %>%
  distinct(f_ref, mass) %>%
  arrange(f_ref, mass) %>%
  mutate(name = paste0("f=", signif(f_ref, 3), " | m=", signif(mass, 3)))

plots_R <- vector("list", nrow(combos))
names(plots_R) <- combos$name

for (i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
  f_i <- combos$f_ref[i]
  m_i <- combos$mass[i]
  nm  <- combos$name[i]

  sub <- surf_F_TpO2space %>% filter(f_ref == f_i, mass == m_i)

  # Build a regular grid for crisp borders between categorical tiles
  xs <- sort(unique(sub$T))
  ys <- sort(unique(sub$pO2))
  Z_tbl <- tidyr::pivot_wider(sub[, c("T","pO2","class_id")],
                              names_from = pO2, values_from = class_id) %>%
           arrange(T)
  Z <- as.matrix(Z_tbl[, -1, drop = FALSE])

  # contour at midpoints between integer class IDs
  brks <- seq(1.5, length(reg_levels) - 0.5, by = 1)
  grid_for_contour <- expand.grid(T = xs, pO2 = ys)
  grid_for_contour$class_id <- as.vector(Z)

  # nice axis ticks
  Tx  <- range(sub$T,  na.rm = TRUE)
  O2x <- range(sub$pO2, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_br <- pretty(Tx, n = 6)
  y_br <- seq(ceiling(O2x[1]/10)*10, floor(O2x[2]/10)*10, by = 10)
  if (length(y_br) == 0) y_br <- pretty(O2x, n = 4)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = sub, aes(T, pO2, fill = regime), interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_contour(
      data = grid_for_contour,
      aes(x = T, y = pO2, z = class_id),
      breaks = brks, colour = "gray60", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = regime_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Regime",
      guide = guide_legend(
        nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE,                # stack keys in two rows
        keywidth  = unit(3, "mm"),
        keyheight = unit(3, "mm"),
        override.aes = list(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      #title = nm,
      x = "Temperature (°C)",
      y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~"(kPa)")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(Tseq), max(Tseq), by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(pO2seq), max(pO2seq), by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_x_continuous(limits = Tx, breaks = x_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_y_continuous(limits = O2x, breaks = y_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio     = 1,
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box       = "horizontal",
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.key       = element_rect(colour = "grey50")
    )

  plots_R[[nm]] <- p
}
```

## Available energy

```{r warning=FALSE}
# Inputs expected:
# - surf_F_TpO2space with cols: f_ref, mass, T, pO2, E_net_norm
# - legend_bar_guide(), base_theme already defined

# Breaks/labels for the colorbar
E_breaks <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
E_labels <- sprintf("%.1f", E_breaks)

E_min <- min(surf_F_preyspace$E_net_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
E_max <- max(surf_F_preyspace$E_net_norm, na.rm = TRUE)

# Find unique (T, mass) combos
combos <- surf_F_preyspace |>
  dplyr::distinct(T, mass) |>
  dplyr::arrange(T, mass) |>
  dplyr::mutate(name = paste0("T=", signif(T, 3), " | m=", signif(mass, 3)))

# Container for plots
plots_Epreyspace <- vector("list", nrow(combos))
names(plots_Epreyspace) <- combos$name

# Build plots in a simple for-loop
for (i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
  f_i <- combos$T[i]
  m_i <- combos$mass[i]
  nm  <- combos$name[i]

  df_i <- dplyr::filter(surf_F_preyspace, T == f_i, mass == m_i)

  # Split like your style
  E_na  <- dplyr::filter(df_i, !is.finite(E_net_norm) | is.na(E_net_norm))
  E_neg <- dplyr::filter(df_i,  is.finite(E_net_norm) & E_net_norm < 0)
  E_pos <- dplyr::filter(df_i,  is.finite(E_net_norm) & E_net_norm >= 0) |>
           dplyr::mutate(E_pos = E_net_norm)

  # Axes ranges & ticks
  Tx  <- range(df_i$T,  na.rm = TRUE)
  O2x <- range(df_i$pO2, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_br <- pretty(Tx, n = 6)
  y_br <- seq(ceiling(O2x[1]/10)*10, floor(O2x[2]/10)*10, by = 10)
  if (length(y_br) == 0) y_br <- pretty(O2x, n = 4)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = E_na,  aes(f_ref, pO2), fill = "black",  interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_raster(data = E_neg, aes(f_ref, pO2), fill = "gray60", interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_raster(data = E_pos, aes(f_ref, pO2, fill = pmin(E_pos, 1)), interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_contour(
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      data = E_pos, aes(x = f_ref, y = pO2, z = E_pos),
      breaks = seq(min(E_pos$E_pos), max(E_pos$E_pos), length.out=5), colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 1, linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    # --- NEW: regime boundary (Food limited vs Oxygen limited) ---
    # Only draw if both regimes are present in this T×mass slice
    # { if (dplyr::n_distinct(na.omit(df_i$class_id)) >= 2)
    #     geom_contour(
    #       inherit.aes = FALSE,
    #       data = df_i,
    #       aes(x = f_ref, y = pO2, z = class_id),
    #       breaks = 3.5,             # midpoint between 3 and 4
    #       #linetype = "dashed",
    #       colour = "black",
    #       linewidth = 0.3
    #     )
    #   else NULL } +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white", high = "#67A5CA", na.value = "black",
      limits = c(0, E_max), breaks = E_breaks, labels = E_labels,
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = expression("Available energy"),
      guide = legend_bar_guide(E_breaks, E_labels)
    ) +
    labs(
      #title = nm,
      x = "Prey index",
      y = expression("Oxygen," ~ p[O[2]] ~ "(kPa)")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(pO2seq), max(pO2seq), by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_x_continuous(limits = Tx,  breaks = x_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_y_continuous(limits = O2x, breaks = y_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio    = 1,
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box      = "horizontal"
    )

  plots_Epreyspace[[nm]] <- p
}
```

```{r fig.height=4.5, fig.width=3.5, warning=FALSE}
p4 <- plots_Epreyspace[[4]] + theme(plot.margin = uniform_margins)   # bottom-right

# apply axis stripping:
# top row: no x labels; left keeps y, right strips y
p1 <- strip_x(p1)                 # keep y
p2 <- strip_x(strip_y(p2))        # strip y

# bottom row: keep x; left keeps y, right strips y
p3 <- p3                          # keep y & x
p4 <- strip_y(p4)                 # strip y, keep x

# assemble 2x2 (p1 p2 / p3 p4)
grid_preyspace_2x2 <-
  ((p1 | p2) /
   (p3 | p4)) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1), heights = c(1, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position      = "bottom",
    legend.direction     = "horizontal",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.key.height = unit(dev.size()[1] / 50, "inches")
  )
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# -----------------------------
# Build per-(f_ref, mass) regime plots over T × pO2
combos <- surf_F_preyspace %>%
  distinct(T, mass) %>%
  arrange(T, mass) %>%
  mutate(name = paste0("T=", signif(T, 3), " | m=", signif(mass, 3)))

plots_R <- vector("list", nrow(combos))
names(plots_R) <- combos$name

for (i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
  f_i <- combos$T[i]
  m_i <- combos$mass[i]
  nm  <- combos$name[i]

  sub <- surf_F_preyspace %>% filter(T == f_i, mass == m_i)

  # Build a regular grid for crisp borders between categorical tiles
  xs <- sort(unique(sub$f_ref))
  ys <- sort(unique(sub$pO2))
  Z_tbl <- tidyr::pivot_wider(sub[, c("f_ref","pO2","class_id")],
                              names_from = pO2, values_from = class_id) %>%
           arrange(T)
  Z <- as.matrix(Z_tbl[, -1, drop = FALSE])

  # contour at midpoints between integer class IDs
  brks <- seq(1.5, length(reg_levels) - 0.5, by = 1)
  grid_for_contour <- expand.grid(f_ref = xs, pO2 = ys)
  grid_for_contour$class_id <- as.vector(Z)

  # nice axis ticks
  Tx  <- range(sub$f_ref,  na.rm = TRUE)
  O2x <- range(sub$pO2, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_br <- pretty(Tx, n = 6)
  y_br <- seq(ceiling(O2x[1]/10)*10, floor(O2x[2]/10)*10, by = 10)
  if (length(y_br) == 0) y_br <- pretty(O2x, n = 4)

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = sub, aes(f_ref, pO2, fill = regime), interpolate = FALSE) +
    geom_contour(
      data = grid_for_contour,
      aes(x = f_ref, y = pO2, z = class_id),
      breaks = brks, colour = "gray60", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = regime_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Regime",
      guide = guide_legend(
        nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE,                # stack keys in two rows
        keywidth  = unit(3, "mm"),
        keyheight = unit(3, "mm"),
        override.aes = list(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      #title = nm,
      x = "Prey index",
      y = expression("Oxygen,"~p[O[2]]~"(kPa)")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(f_seq), max(f_seq), by = 0.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(pO2seq), max(pO2seq), by = 5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_x_continuous(limits = Tx, breaks = x_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    #scale_y_continuous(limits = O2x, breaks = y_br, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio     = 1,
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box       = "horizontal",
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.key       = element_rect(colour = "grey50")
    )

  plots_R[[nm]] <- p
}
```

## Metabolic allocation

```{r}
# Build a surface for one scenario via compute_state_surface()
.build_surface_for_scenario <- function(tr, sc_row, masses,
                                        prey_mode = c("prey_index","feeding_level","powerlaw"),
                                        T_ref = 10, pO2_ref = 25) {
  prey_mode <- match.arg(prey_mode)
  Tj   <- sc_row$T
  pO2j <- sc_row$pO2
  fj   <- sc_row$f
  intj <- sc_row$int
  slpj <- sc_row$slope

  if (prey_mode %in% c("prey_index","feeding_level")) {
    compute_state_surface(
      tr,
      masses     = masses,
      Tseq       = Tj,
      pO2seq     = pO2j,
      prey_units = prey_mode,   # "prey_index" = fixed B; "feeding_level" = B(T)
      preys      = fj,          # T
      pair_mode  = "cross",
      normalize_E = FALSE,
      progress    = FALSE,
      T_ref = T_ref, pO2_ref = pO2_ref
    ) %>% mutate(scenario = sc_row$scenario)
  } else {
    compute_state_surface(
      tr,
      masses     = masses,
      Tseq       = Tj,
      pO2seq     = pO2j,
      prey_units = "powerlaw",
      intercepts = intj,
      slopes     = slpj,
      pair_mode  = "cross",
      normalize_E = FALSE,
      progress    = FALSE
    ) %>% mutate(scenario = sc_row$scenario)
  }
}

# Convert a surface to Cmax-normalized allocation (long)
.alloc_long_from_surface <- function(surf, tr) {
  if (!"unassim" %in% names(surf) || all(!is.finite(surf$unassim))) {
    if (!("f" %in% names(surf) && "Cmax" %in% names(surf))) {
      stop("Need 'f' and 'Cmax' to reconstruct unassim; not found in surface.")
    }
    surf <- surf %>% mutate(unassim = (1 - tr$epsAssim) * f * Cmax)
  }
  surf %>%
    transmute(
      scenario, mass,
      'Available energy'  = pmax(0, ifelse(Cmax > 0 & is.finite(E_net), E_net / Cmax, NA_real_)),
      #'Unassimilated'     = pmax(0, ifelse(Cmax > 0 & is.finite(unassim), unassim / Cmax, NA_real_)),
      'Excretion'         = pmax(0, ifelse(Cmax > 0 & is.finite(unassim), unassim*(1/3) / Cmax, NA_real_)),
      'SDA'               = pmax(0, ifelse(Cmax > 0 & is.finite(unassim), unassim*(2/3) / Cmax, NA_real_)),
      'Active metabolism' = pmax(0, ifelse(Cmax > 0 & is.finite(M_act),  M_act  / Cmax, NA_real_)),
      'Basal metabolism'  = pmax(0, ifelse(Cmax > 0 & is.finite(M_m),    M_m    / Cmax, NA_real_))
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      #cols = c(`Available energy`,`Unassimilated`,`Active metabolism`,`Basal metabolism`),
      cols = c('Available energy','Excretion','SDA','Active metabolism','Basal metabolism'),
      names_to = "component", values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    # mutate(component = factor(component,
    #                           levels = c("Available energy","Unassimilated",
    #                                      "Active metabolism","Basal metabolism")))
    mutate(component = factor(component,
                              levels = c("Available energy","Excretion","SDA",
                                         "Active metabolism","Basal metabolism")))
}

# Optional light smoothing over log10(mass)
.smooth_alloc <- function(df, n = 400) {
  safe_spline <- function(x, y) {
    ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y); x <- x[ok]; y <- y[ok]
    if (!length(x)) return(function(xx) rep(NA_real_, length(xx)))
    x <- x[order(x)]; y <- y[order(x)]
    xu <- unique(x); yu <- vapply(xu, function(xx) mean(y[x==xx]), numeric(1))
    if (length(xu) == 1L) return(function(xx) rep(yu[1], length(xx)))
    if (length(xu) == 2L) return(approxfun(xu, yu))
    tryCatch(splinefun(xu, yu, method="hyman"), error = function(e) splinefun(xu, yu, method="fmm"))
  }
  comps <- levels(df$component)
  xr <- range(log10(df$mass[is.finite(df$mass) & df$mass>0]), na.rm = TRUE)
  xs <- seq(xr[1], xr[2], length.out = n)
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(comps, function(cc){
    sub <- dplyr::filter(df, component == cc)
    s   <- safe_spline(log10(sub$mass), sub$value)
    tibble::tibble(mass = 10^xs, component = factor(cc, levels = comps), value = pmax(0, s(xs)))
  }))
}

# Plot one scenario (returns ggplot)
.plot_alloc <- function(df_alloc, scenario_label,
                        mass_breaks, mass_labels_fun,
                        stack_cols = c(
                          "Available energy"  = "#67A5CA",
                          "Excretion"         = "gray90",
                          "SDA"               = "#e0bce8", #"gray75",
                          #"Unassimilated"     = "gray85",
                          "Active metabolism" = "#8a5796", #"gray60",
                          "Basal metabolism"  = "#440154" #"black"
                        )) {
  x_min <- min(df_alloc$mass, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(df_alloc$mass, na.rm = TRUE)
  ggplot(df_alloc, aes(x = mass, y = value, fill = component)) +
    geom_area(position = "stack", color = "grey15", linewidth = 0.3) +
    #scale_fill_manual(values = stack_cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = stack_cols,
      drop   = FALSE,
      name   = "Process",
      guide  = guide_legend(
        nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE,              # <-- one rows
        keywidth  = unit(3, "mm"),
        keyheight = unit(3,  "mm"),
        override.aes = list(                  # <-- add grey border to swatches
          colour   = "grey50",
          size      = 0.5,                     # border thickness (stroke)
          linewidth = 0.5
        )
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      #title = scenario_label,
      x = "Individual size (g)",
      #y = expression("Metabolic allocation " * (italic(C)[max] * "-normalized"))
      y = expression("Metabolic allocation")
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(
      limits = c(x_min, x_max),
      breaks = mass_breaks,
      labels = mass_labels_fun,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio   = 1,
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text  = element_text(size=6, color="black"),
      legend.key = element_rect(colour = "gray50"),
      legend.title      = element_blank()
    ) 
}

# ==========================================================
# PUBLIC: returns a LIST of ggplots (no combination)
# ==========================================================
make_allocation_plots <- function(tr, scenarios, mass_grid,
                                  prey_mode = c("prey_index","feeding_level","powerlaw"),
                                  smooth = TRUE,
                                  T_ref = 10, pO2_ref = 25,
                                  mass_breaks = 10^seq(-2, 5, by = 1),
                                  mass_labels_fun = function(b) parse(text = paste0("10^", log10(b)))
                                  ) {
  prey_mode <- match.arg(prey_mode)

  out_plots <- vector("list", nrow(scenarios))
  names(out_plots) <- as.character(scenarios$scenario)

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(scenarios))) {
    sc_row <- scenarios[j, , drop = FALSE]

    # 1) surface
    surf <- .build_surface_for_scenario(tr, sc_row, masses = mass_grid,
                                        prey_mode = prey_mode,
                                        T_ref = T_ref, pO2_ref = pO2_ref)

    # 2) allocation
    alloc_long <- .alloc_long_from_surface(surf, tr)

    # 3) optional smoothing
    if (isTRUE(smooth)) {
      alloc_long <- alloc_long %>%
        group_by(scenario) %>%
        group_modify(~ .smooth_alloc(.x)) %>%
        ungroup()
    }

    # 4) plot
    lbl <- paste0(
      as.character(sc_row$scenario), "\n"#,
      #sc_row$T, "°C, ", sc_row$pO2, " kPa, f = ", sc_row$f
    )
    out_plots[[j]] <- .plot_alloc(alloc_long %>% filter(scenario == sc_row$scenario),
                                  scenario_label = lbl,
                                  mass_breaks = mass_breaks,
                                  mass_labels_fun = mass_labels_fun)
  }

  out_plots  # return list only
}
```

```{r}
# Parameters
masses   <- 10^seq(-1, 6.5, length.out = 300)                                                         # [g]

f_seq  <- c(0.9)                                             # []

# Calculate surface
line_F_speed <- compute_state_surface(
  tr,                                                                           # consider re-adjusting if you add other functional groups
  masses = masses,
  Tseq = Tseq,
  pO2seq = pO2seq,
  preys = f_seq,
  prey_units = "prey_index", 
  pair_mode = "cross"
)


# Fit power law to theoretical U_opt vs mass
fit_theory <- lm(
  log10(U_opt) ~ log10(mass),
  data = line_F_speed
)

summary(fit_theory)   # slope b_th, intercept a_th

a_th <- coef(fit_theory)[1]   # log10(c_th)
b_th <- coef(fit_theory)[2]   # theoretical scaling exponent

```


```{r fig.height=4.5, fig.width=3.5, warning=FALSE}
# Dummy length–weight (TL in cm → mass in g)
a_dummy <- 0.010
b_dummy <- 3.00

# 1. Add mass (g) from length (cm)
#    M = a * L^b, with a ≈ 0.01, b ≈ 3
speed_df2 <- speed_df %>%
  mutate(
    mass_g = a_dummy * (length^b_dummy)   # mass in grams
  )

# 2. Fit power law: log10(U) = a + b * log10(mass)
fit_free <- lm(
  log10(speed_mpers) ~ log10(mass_g),
  data = speed_df2
)

summary(fit_free)   # look at slope b_hat and its SE

# Extract slope and intercept for the free model
a_hat <- coef(fit_free)[1]             # log10(c_hat)
b_hat <- coef(fit_free)[2]             # scaling exponent

# 3. Fit model with slope fixed to 1/6:
#    log10(U) = log10(c_1_6) + (1/6)*log10(mass)
fit_1_6 <- lm(
  log10(speed_mpers) ~ offset((1/6) * log10(mass_g)),
  data = speed_df2
)

c_1_6 <- 10^coef(fit_1_6)[1]          # c for the constrained 1/6 model
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3.5, warning=FALSE}
library(tibble)

# Data frame for the two empirical straight lines
abline_df <- tibble(
  slope       = c(b_hat,        1/6),
  intercept   = c(a_hat,        log10(c_1_6)),
  relationship = c("Empirical fit",
                   "Empirical w^(1/6) fit")
)

p_Usize <- ggplot(speed_df2, aes(x = mass_g, y = speed_mpers)) +

  # Theoretical curve from line_F_speed (model output)
```

```{r}
# Parameters
masses   <- c(1e0, 1e4)                                                         # [g]

# Calculate surface
surf_F_preyspace <- compute_state_surface(
  tr,                                                                           # consider re-adjusting if you add other functional groups
  masses = masses,
  Tseq = Tseq,

  prey_units = "prey_index",

)

surf_F_preyspace <- surf_F_preyspace %>%
  mutate(M_sda = 0.2 * consump)
```

```{r}
# --- 1) Build MT + scenario labels ---
df_plot <- surf_F_preyspace %>%
  mutate(
    M_T = (M_m + M_act + M_sda) / M_m,
    scenario = case_when(
      T == 5  & f_ref == 0.8 ~ "Baseline / Hypoxic (T=5, f_ref=0.8)",
      T == 25 & f_ref == 0.8 ~ "Hyperthermic (T=25, f_ref=0.8)",
      T == 5  & f_ref == 0.4 ~ "Low food (T=5, f_ref=0.4)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    scenario = factor(
      scenario,
      levels = c(
        "Baseline / Hypoxic (T=5, f_ref=0.8)",
        "Hyperthermic (T=25, f_ref=0.8)",
        "Low food (T=5, f_ref=0.4)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  # Keep only the scenario families we want
  filter(!is.na(scenario)) %>%
  # Keep only the masses of interest
  filter(mass %in% c(1e0, 1e4))

# --- 2) Make two "sub-scenarios" inside the T=5, f_ref=0.8 family:
#         baseline (pO2=25 reference point) vs hypoxic (pO2=10 reference point)
#         This is just for labeling emphasis; both are already represented along the pO2 curve.
df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  mutate(
    scenario2 = case_when(
      scenario == "Baseline / Hypoxic (T=5, f_ref=0.8)" ~ "Baseline (T=5, f_ref=0.8)",
      scenario == "Hyperthermic (T=25, f_ref=0.8)" ~ "Hyperthermic (T=25, f_ref=0.8)",
      scenario == "Low food (T=5, f_ref=0.4)" ~ "Low food (T=5, f_ref=0.4)",
      TRUE ~ as.character(scenario)
    ),
    scenario2 = factor(
      scenario2,
      levels = c(
        "Baseline (T=5, f_ref=0.8)",
        "Hyperthermic (T=25, f_ref=0.8)",
        "Low food (T=5, f_ref=0.4)"
      )
    )
  )

# --- 3) Plot: facet by mass (gives you both plots in one figure) ---
p_MT_pO2 <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = pO2, y = M_T, colour = scenario2)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ mass, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_bquote(mass == .(mass))) +
  labs(
    x = expression(pO[2]~"(kPa)"),
    y = expression(M[T]~"="~M[m] + M[act] + M[sda]),
    colour = "Scenario"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_MT_pO2


# --- 4) Plot: facet by mass (gives you both plots in one figure) ---
p_MT_U <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = pO2, y = U_opt, colour = scenario2)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ mass, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_bquote(mass == .(mass))) +
  labs(
```

## Q10 tests

```{r}
# --- 1) Effective-Q10 helper (works on E_net or E_net_norm) -------------
Q10_eff <- function(val_T1, val_T2, T1, T2) (val_T2/val_T1)^(10/(T2 - T1))

q10_grid <- function(surf, T1, T2, value_col = c("E_net", "E_net_norm", "E_mass_norm"),
                     hold_cols = c("mass","pO2")) {
  value_col <- match.arg(value_col)
  d1 <- subset(surf, T == T1)
  d2 <- subset(surf, T == T2)
  key <- hold_cols
  m   <- merge(d1[, c(key, value_col)], d2[, c(key, value_col)],
               by = key, suffixes = c("1","2"))
  names(m)[names(m) == paste0(value_col,"1")] <- "v1"
  names(m)[names(m) == paste0(value_col,"2")] <- "v2"
  transform(m, Q10 = Q10_eff(v1, pmax(v2, 1e-12), T1, T2))
}


T1 <- 10; T2 <- 20
masses  <- c(1e0, 1e2, 1e4)
pO2_vec <- seq(0, 30, by = 1)
f_ref   <- 0.6

# (i) Fixed prey density across T: "prey_index"
surf_fixed <- compute_state_surface(
  tr, masses, Tseq = c(T1, T2), pO2seq = pO2_vec,
  prey_units = "prey_index", preys = f_ref, pair_mode = "cross",
  normalize_E = TRUE
)
surf_fixed$E_mass_norm <- surf_fixed$E_net / surf_fixed$mass ^ 0.75
q10_fixed <- q10_grid(surf_fixed, T1, T2, value_col = "E_mass_norm")

# (ii) Keep feeding level constant vs T (B recalculated at each T): "feeding_level"
surf_covary <- compute_state_surface(
  tr, masses, Tseq = c(T1, T2), pO2seq = pO2_vec,
  prey_units = "feeding_level", preys = f_ref, pair_mode = "cross",
  normalize_E = TRUE
)
surf_covary$E_mass_norm <- surf_covary$E_net / surf_covary$mass ^ 0.75
q10_covary <- q10_grid(surf_covary, T1, T2, value_col = "E_mass_norm")

# Quick visualization: realized Q10 distributions
viz_q10 <- bind_rows(
  mutate(q10_fixed,  mode = "Fixed prey (prey_index)"),
  mutate(q10_covary, mode = "Constant f (feeding_level)")
)
ggplot(viz_q10, aes(x = pO2, y = Q10, color = factor(mass))) +
  #geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.1, linetype = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ mode) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.6, 3)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Mass (g)") +
  labs(x = expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)"),
       y = expression("Realized " * Q[10] * " of " * nu),
       title = "Effective Q10 of available energy across O2 and size") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```


```{r}
# ---------------------------
# Config
# ---------------------------
Tseq_plot   <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.5)
masses_plot <- c(1, 1e4)             # 1 g and 10 kg
pO2_vals    <- c(25, 15, 5)
f_ref       <- 0.6

# ---------------------------
# Build surface (keeps your style)
# Choose either prey_index or feeding_level; here: feeding_level
# ---------------------------
surf <- compute_state_surface(
  tr, masses_plot, Tseq = Tseq_plot, pO2seq = pO2_vals,
  prey_units = "prey_index", preys = f_ref, pair_mode = "cross",
  normalize_E = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(
    E_mass_norm = E_net / (mass ^ 0.75),
    mass_lab = factor(ifelse(mass < 10, "1 g", "10 kg"),
                      levels = c("1 g","10 kg")),
    pO2_lab  = factor(paste0(pO2, " kPa"), levels = paste0(pO2_vals, " kPa"))
  ) %>%
  filter(E_mass_norm > 0)   # log-scale safe-guard

# ---------------------------
# Reference Q10 lines (Q10 = 2 and Q10 = 1)
# In log10-space, slope m = log10(Q10)/10 per °C, anchor at (T0=10, y0=10)
# ---------------------------
T0 <- 10
y0 <- 10
m_Q10_2 <- log10(2) / 10
m_Q10_1 <- log10(1.1) / 10#0

b0_Q10_2 <- log10(y0) - m_Q10_2 * T0
b0_Q10_1 <- log10(y0) - m_Q10_1 * T0

ref_lines <- tibble(
  T = rep(Tseq_plot, 2),
  E_ref = c(10^(b0_Q10_2 + m_Q10_2*Tseq_plot),
            10^(b0_Q10_1 + m_Q10_1*Tseq_plot)),
  ref = rep(c("Q10 = 2.0 (ref)", "Q10 = 1.1 (ref)"), each = length(Tseq_plot))
)

# ---------------------------
# Plot (points only for your model outputs)
# ---------------------------
ggplot() +
  # Reference Q10 lines
  geom_line(data = ref_lines,
            aes(x = T, y = E_ref, linetype = ref),
            color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +

  # Model points by pO2 (no fits)
  geom_point(data = surf,
             aes(x = T, y = E_net, color = pO2_lab),
             size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +

  facet_wrap(~ mass_lab, nrow = 1) +

  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100),
    limits = c(1, 100),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Q10 = 2.0 (ref)" = "dashed",
                                   "Q10 = 1.1 (ref)" = "solid"),
                        name = "Reference Q10") +

  labs(x = "Temperature (°C)",
       y = expression(E[mass~norm]),
       title = expression("Available energy vs temperature (points only)"),
       subtitle = "Colors = pO2 (kPa); grey lines = Q10 reference slopes") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Config
# -----------------------------
f_target <- 0.5
eps <- 1e-6            # to avoid divide-by-zero if min pO2 hits 0
singleton_as_one <- TRUE  # if only one O2-limited cell at a T, return 1 (else NA)

# -----------------------------
# 0) Slice feeding_level = 0.6 (exact if present; else nearest)
# -----------------------------
has_exact <- any(abs(surf_F_TpO2space$f_ref - f_target) < 1e-9, na.rm = TRUE)
surf_slice <- if (has_exact) {
  surf_F_TpO2space %>% filter(abs(f_ref - f_target) < 1e-9)
} else {
  f_near <- surf_F_TpO2space %>%
    summarize(f_near = f_ref[which.min(abs(f_ref - f_target))]) %>% pull(f_near)
  message(sprintf("Note: f_ref=%.2f not found; using nearest f_ref=%.2f", f_target, f_near))
  surf_F_TpO2space %>% filter(f_ref == f_near)
}

# Ensure regime labels exist in surf_slice (you already called add_regime_labels upstream)

# -----------------------------
# 1) Compute min/max oxygen-limited pO2 and the ratio per (mass, T)
# -----------------------------
ratio_df <- surf_slice %>%
  select(mass, T, pO2, regime) %>%
  group_by(mass, T) %>%
  summarize(
    n_oxlim = sum(regime == "Oxygen limited", na.rm = TRUE),
    pO2_min = if (n_oxlim > 0) min(pO2[regime == "Oxygen limited"], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    pO2_max = if (n_oxlim > 0) max(pO2[regime == "Oxygen limited"], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_raw = ifelse(n_oxlim == 0, NA_real_,
                       ifelse(n_oxlim == 1 & singleton_as_one, 1, (pO2_max + eps) / (pO2_min + eps))),
    ratio = ratio_raw
  )

# Pretty mass labels
mass_lab <- function(m) ifelse(m >= 1000, paste0(signif(m/1000, 3), " kg"),
                               paste0(signif(m, 3), " g"))
ratio_df <- ratio_df %>%
  mutate(mass_lab = factor(mass_lab(mass),
                           levels = unique(mass_lab(sort(unique(mass))))))

# -----------------------------
# 2A) Plot: ratio vs Temperature (one line per mass)
# -----------------------------
p_ratio_lines <-
  ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = T, y = ratio, color = mass_lab)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  # scale_y_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 5, 10),
  #               labels = c("1", "2", "5", "10"),
  #               minor_breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Temperature (°C)",
       y = "max(pO₂) / min(pO₂) in O₂-limited band",
       color = "Mass",
       title = "Oxygen-limited pO₂ span (ratio) vs temperature",
       subtitle = sprintf("feeding_level = %.2f; %s for single-cell spans",
                          f_target,
                          ifelse(singleton_as_one, "ratio=1", "ratio=NA"))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_ratio_lines

# -----------------------------
# 2B) Optional heatmap: T × Mass with ratio as fill
# -----------------------------
p_ratio_heat <-
  ratio_df %>%
  mutate(mass_f = factor(mass_lab)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = T, y = mass_f, fill = ratio)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(#trans = "log10",
                       #breaks = c(1, 2, 5, 10),
                       na.value = "grey85",
                       name = "max/min\n(pO₂)") +
  labs(x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "Mass",
       title = "Relative span of O₂-limited regime (pO₂ max/min)",
       subtitle = sprintf("feeding_level = %.2f", f_target)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# print if desired
p_ratio_heat
```
